newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Placer in talks with Bre-X on Busang.
newsitem.headline: Placer in talks with Bre-X on Busang.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc is holding talks with Bre-X Minerals Ltd on its proposed $5 billion merger with the company to develop the huge Busang gold find in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province, Placer chief executive officer John Willson told Reuters on Friday.
"We have had a number of conversations and a number of meetings, and that meetings will continue. There's been quite a lot of contact but one major meeting," he said in an interview in Jakarta.

"I think Bre-X is pleased that we have made the proposal because I think Bre-X is attracted to Placer Dome as somebody to merge with. It happens the relationship between us is good," he said. "I'm hopeful we can work it out."
Willson said under the proposed merger, Bre-X shareholders would hold about 45 to 55 percent equity in the merged entity, and Placer shareholders would hold a similar amount of shares.
"That merged company will have Busang as its asset plus all our mines and our exploration properties," he said.
"On Busang, we can create an arrangement whereby the combined company will hold 60 percent and the Indonesian interests the rest," he said.
He said Placer would come up with the money to develop the find and, depending on the arrangment, might be repaid over a period of time from the proceeds of the property.
Bre-X estimates the deposit contains at least 57 million ounces of gold worth over $21 billion at current prices.
The Indonesian government has given Bre-X and Barrick Gold Corp until February 17 to settle with their local partners or everything discussed previously would be cancelled.
Willson said that the deadline could mean that Barrick was the only possible partner to Bre-X.
"But on the other hand, it gives us time to convince the Indonesian government and Bre-X that we would be a better partner for them. On the whole I am very encouraged," he said.

Willson also said he had held talks with influential Indonesian businessman Muhammad "Bob" Hasan on how Placer could "get into the competition for being a partner of Bre-X and the Indonesian people and developing Busang.
"We came to him and asked him if he thought there might be a possibility...and he seemed to think there might be a possibility," he said.
"That's why we have been continuing to try," he said.
He said the talks have been encouraging but have not resulted in anything concrete yet.
Hasan recently acquired a 50-percent stake in PT Askatindo Karya Minerals, which has a 10-percent stake in Busang II and III, the richest parts of the property, in partnership with Bre-X.
